summary: Bidirectional Forwarding Detection normally needs a control session between two systems. This RFC lets a system use the BFD Echo function on its own, with no matching control session at the other end. It helps quickly detect forwarding path failures where setting up full BFD on both sides is not practical.

eli5.summary: You throw a ball at a wall and catch it when it bounces back. If it does not come back, something is blocking the way. Nobody needs to stand behind the wall.

questions: bfd echo without a control session
